simple.meaning: רָחַף (râchaph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to brood ; by implication, to be relaxed.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H7363. rachaph I. [ רָחַף ] verb grow soft, relax (compare Arabic be soft ); — Qal Perfect 3plural רָֽחֲפוּ Jer 23:9 (bones of one appalled). II. רָחַף verb Pi`el hover (Late Hebrew id. , compare Grünbaum ZMG xxxix (1885), 607 ; Syriac Pa`el move Gently , also cherish , and brood , compare Thes s. see; connection with I. ׳ר dubious); — Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine singular עַל יְרַחֵף Deut 32:11 (poem) of vulture hovering over young; Participle א ׳רוּחַ הַמָּ֑יִם עַלמְּֿנֵי מְרַחֶפֶת Gen 1:2 (P); hovering over face of waters, or perhaps (see Syriac) brooding (and fertilizing), so Jer Quaest. in Gen. ed. Lag. 4 (reading ' marahaefeth ), compare Di Gunk.
